{{Top|leg}}
'''Yedagon City Air Base''' was a military air base in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Yedagon City|Yedagon]]. It was the staging area of the largest air force assembled against the nation of [[Cartann]], which was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Adumari Civil War]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
